random_tasks: Cold boot: run the clip pipeline from clean (npm run clips:clean && npm run clips) and report anything that fails or warns
E2E pass: run npm run test:e2e and triage every failure into reproduction steps
Visual pass: run npm run test:visual and inspect the diffs — a changed screenshot is either a bug or a stale reference, decide which
Project switch: exercise every project in projects/index.json through the mainframe API and report any that fail to load
Malformed input: feed the mainframe API a clip with a bad field (wrong type, missing frames, oversized body) and check it fails cleanly rather than writing junk
Pipeline round-trip: hand-write a meta.json, run the pipeline, and confirm the output still matches what a human wrote
Boundary check: run the full suite with the clip catalog empty, and again with a project that has no key-map
